# Orlowsky Discovery Hotel

> Four-star boutique beachfront hotel in Candidasa, East Bali, Indonesia. Ocean-view cottages and villas set in tropical gardens, with a seaside restaurant and bar, Ayurvedic spa, diving and snorkeling, tours, and weddings and events.

Address: Jalan Pantai Indah 06, Candidasa, Karangasem 80851, Bali, Indonesia.
Direct booking, no middleman. WhatsApp +62 822 3665 5582 · Email info@orlowsky.co.id.
